decisions.reason: The revised bushing retention and motion arrangement does not change the specified shaft material, fabrication sequence, premachining purpose, or post-weld 82 mm internal machining.
The source does not change the M72x1.5 locking interface or the specified 65 mm bushing-space length; that space can remain applicable to the revised sliding arrangement.
Changing how the bushing is retained and slides does not alter the independent requirement to omit the keyway at cross section C-C.
The mechanical arrangement change does not affect the requirement to align drawing numbering with assembly position numbering.
The source changes the bushing's location, retention, and motion but does not change its CuSn12 material or the default material for other parts.
The revised bushing arrangement has no stated effect on the independent 120-degree lug-hole spacing.
The source requests a revised mechanical arrangement but does not change any current dimension-content or presentation attribute, and implementation status must not be propagated.
The bushing arrangement does not alter the requirement for compliance with the usual ČSN/EN drawing standards.
The source changes model content but does not change the required IPT preference or STEP minimum file format.
